reviews.title: Each iOS calendar version is becoming more and more unusable
reviews.text:
The changes made to the calendar in iOS 18 make the app literally unusable. It is loaded with unnecessary clutter on each entry.  The dark bar up the left side of each block is unnecessary. The multiple tiny icons crammed into each entry are unnecessary and makes it difficult to read the calendar in week view.  The new version reduced visibility and ease of use for me as a business owner.  If you have back-to-back appointments, it smashes the appointments in half so that they are unreadable and slams one far left and the next one far right. Unless they restore the app back to the previous version I will have to find an alternative.

iOS 27 update: All of the same problems from iOS 18 exist except now I can no longer use the “Location” function because it will only allow specific preprogrammed USPS addresses instead of actual locations like “3rd floor conference room”. Even worse is that in daily view, it opens the date at 12am automatically and you have to scroll down to actual business hours. My day has become incredibly inefficient with the time it takes to repeatedly having to scroll off 12am. There should be basic settings that allow for the “start of day” time to be modified.

I have dropped my rating from 3 to 2 and have given up on Apple providing a basic calendar with customizable settings

reviews.title: No End Time Please 🙏🏽
reviews.text:
Dear Apple Team,

I have been requesting this feature for many years.

Please kindly add an option in iOS 27 Apple Calendar to create a “time-only” event without mandatory start and end duration.

Many professional users, business owners, and busy people only need a simple one-time booking reminder such as 4:25 PM — without the automatic one-hour block.

Please give users the choice to disable event duration completely if they wish.

It would make Apple Calendar much simpler, cleaner, and more practical for real-world daily use.

Thank you very much, and I sincerely hope Apple listens to long-time users on this matter in iOS 27, 

Then no doubt my review will change from this to 5 star straightaway, please email me, thank you 

Kind regards

reviews.title: Search functionality disastrous
reviews.text: I have been using my iPhone calendar for my self employment for years. Lately it is just shocking. At the end of the month I will search my clients’ names and search will simply omit dates, as well as showing dates that were changed and absolutely failing when repeat sessions are changed (often still showing them before change, or not at all). So frustrating. Unhappy clients, having to search the entire month manually. Seriously Apple? It’s a basic feature and supplied as standard with your phones. Awful. Please fix.

reviews.title: EVERYTHING gone?!
reviews.text: I did use calendar to record everything - and suddenly with no warning whatsoever every single event (bar birthdays) are gone!!!! I have no idea when all my family’s health appointments are, where and when I am working, what days I have different events - absolutely no idea. I have adhd and calendar is a lifeline for me. It is a complete disaster. Forums suggest this happens to people regularly although it’s first time for me. If Apple can’t restore everything there is no way I am trusting it ever again. I hear Google have a good calendar app.

reviews.title: Deletes entries older than 6 months
reviews.text: I rely on being able to see old appointments for many reasons eg to do my accounts, tax returns, hospital follow ups etc. Although I have my settings set to ‘sync all’ for the calendar app and do not have any other calendars, the app still deletes all appointments older than 6 months (apart from repeating ones). I am having to look for other calendar apps to use as a result which is a big inconvenience as I heavily rely on this app and use it all day every day.

reviews.title: If low storage - all saved items are deleted without warning
reviews.text: Be very careful, without warning this app will delete EVERYTHING saved in your calendar, if storage is low which mine is. It’s happened twice now- no warnings about this whatsoever. Unacceptable and would be an easy fix.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work like I want
reviews.text:
The calendar is great in theory but two issues I keep finding 1 is the search function keeps stopping working and previously I could toggle the search function off and on again in settings and it would fix it for a time but now that doesn’t work. 2 I used to be able to send my husband invites to things but now he doesn’t receive them. 
Also I wish there was an option to set repeat entries for just week days or certain days of the week instead of all 7 days being the only option

reviews.title: Deleted all my events
reviews.text:
I save EVERYTHING— my information for dates, appointments, work stuff, and just personal things on my agenda —in my calendar app. The NIGHT before I had a bit of a packed day and really was relying what I had marked on the app to remember where I was supposed to be and when, it just deleted everything. Seemingly randomly. Seemingly on its own. Google told me to re-sync my icloud, but nothing was saved, allegedly. I had to scramble last minute to get all the information I needed and reorganize my day before it even started, and it was still a complete mess. It wouldn’t even let me make new events so I had to get a whole different app that has incredibly bad UI, comparatively. 

Most of that definitely falls on me, ultimately, but a calendar app should really not be deciding to wholly reset on its own like it seems to have done. I do not think it is at all possible I accidentally deleted it myself since I wouldn’t even know how to begin with wiping the whole app like this. Not even my subbed calendars are on there, nor the categorized color tags I made. Safe to say I’m not relying on this app again. I’m just going to a paper calendar like a boomer because ALL these apps seem to have these random janky problems lol.
